description: Start watching the web for this person: a page (url) for changes, or a topic (query, optionally limited to some domains) for anything new published about it. Creates a Cloud Agent that runs `prompt` each time something turns up. Use it, not draft_cloud_agent, for 'tell me when <page> changes' or 'let me know about <topic>'. Pass exactly one of url or query; a topic finds only what appears after it starts. preview: true reads a page the way a watch would and saves nothing (1 credit): 'everything' answers at once, a preset or description returns a preview_key while the read runs (a minute or two); call again with preview: true and that preview_key for the read, and pass the same preview_key when starting the watch to reuse it. Returns the monitor and the agent; a preset's first read shows status pending_baseline. In the YouSpot chat it creates nothing: it returns a draft_id for the confirmation card, which creates the agent when the person taps. The card shows the page as read, so in chat a page watch reads the page once for 1 credit unless preview_key is passed.

domains.description: Topics only: just these sites, e.g. ['acme.com', 'acme.com/blog']. Leave out for the whole web.

frequency.description: How often to check. Hourly needs a Pro plan; Free is weekly only.

name.description: A short name for the agent.

preview.description: true reads the page without saving anything.

preview_key.description: A preview of the same page and watch, pprev_...

prompt.description: What the agent does with each change or finding. Default for a page: "Summarize what changed on the page and why it matters to me."

query.description: What to watch the web for, in plain words, e.g. 'Acme product launches'.

watch.description: Pages only. What to watch: 'everything' (the default) for any meaningful change on the page, a preset (pricing, team, products, jobs, headline) for those fields only, or the person's own words, e.g. 'the number of open engineering roles'.

name: watch_web
title: Watch the web
